name: GLBT Historical Society Museum
description: Free first Wednesdays, free for SNAP/Medi-Cal cardholders, and $6 reduced admission
fullDescription: The GLBT Historical Society Museum in the Castro preserves and exhibits LGBTQ+ history, culture, and arts, with free admission on the first Wednesday of each month, free entry for SNAP/Medi-Cal cardholders, and reduced rates available.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free admission the first Wednesday of every month
- Free for SNAP/Medi-Cal cardholders plus up to 3 guests
- Free for children 12 and under
- General admission $10
- $6 for youth 13-17, seniors 65+, students/teachers, active-duty military, and people with disabilities
- LGBTQ+ history exhibitions
- Research archives access by appointment
howToGetIt:
1. Visit on the first Wednesday of the month for free admission
2. Or show your SNAP/Medi-Cal card for free entry
3. Or pay admission ($10 general, $6 reduced with ID)
4. Check website for current exhibitions and hours
5. Access archives (989 Market St) by appointment: reference@glbthistory.org
keywords: GLBT Historical Society, Castro, San Francisco, LGBTQ museum, gay history, lesbian history, free admission, First Wednesday, SNAP, Medi-Cal, Museums for All, senior discount, student discount
